title: Scroll Rotate Gallery
desc: Seven editorial cards travel around a circular fan as the local panel scrolls. The card nearest the focus axis is selected from angular distance, then raised, sharpened, and scaled without relying on hard-coded active ranges.
hint: Images turn around a shared centre
sourceName: Seen on: art archives, fashion lookbooks, festival lineups, and portfolio project selectors

<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Scroll Rotate Gallery</title>

<style>

  /* primitives (hidden in Figma): neutral greys, no warm tint */
  --p-gray-0:#FFFFFF;--p-gray-25:#FAFAFA;--p-gray-50:#F4F4F4;--p-gray-100:#EAEAEA;--p-gray-200:#D6D6D6;
  --p-gray-300:#B4B4B4;--p-gray-400:#8C8C8C;--p-gray-500:#6B6B6B;--p-gray-600:#4A4A4A;--p-gray-700:#2A2A2A;
  --p-gray-750:#222222;--p-gray-800:#1C1C1C;--p-gray-850:#151515;--p-gray-900:#101010;--p-gray-950:#0A0A0A;
  --p-orange-400:#FF8A3D;--p-orange-500:#FA7319;--p-orange-600:#E0600A;
  --p-green-500:#3ECF8E;--p-green-600:#1FA866;--p-red-500:#F26D6D;--p-red-600:#D63A40;

  /* semantic: dark (default) */
  --bg-canvas:var(--p-gray-850);--bg-surface:var(--p-gray-800);--bg-raised:var(--p-gray-750);
  --bg-stage:var(--p-gray-850);--bg-overlay:var(--p-gray-700);
  --border-subtle:rgba(255,255,255,.06);--border-default:rgba(255,255,255,.09);--border-strong:rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  --border-highlight:rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  --text-primary:#F1F1F1;--text-secondary:#A0A0A0;--text-tertiary:#949494;--text-inverse:var(--p-gray-950);
  --accent-default:var(--p-orange-500);--accent-hover:var(--p-orange-400);--accent-subtle:rgba(250,115,25,.14);
  --pro-default:var(--text-primary);--status-success:var(--p-green-500);--status-danger:var(--p-red-500);--focus-ring:var(--p-orange-400);
  /* tints: 13% chip fills with the full hue on the icon; never decorative */
  --tint-amber:#F5B544;--tint-violet:#A78BFA;--tint-cyan:#38BDF8;--tint-pink:#F472B6;--tint-blue:#4C9BFF;--tint-green:#3ECF8E;--tint-red:#F26D6D;

  /* space · radius · motion (motion tokens: see MOTION_SYSTEM.md, which supersedes these) */
  --space-half:2px;--space-1:4px;--space-2:8px;--space-3:12px;--space-4:16px;--space-5:20px;--space-6:24px;
  --space-8:32px;--space-10:40px;--space-14:56px;--space-20:80px;
  --radius-xs:6px;--radius-sm:8px;--radius-md:12px;--radius-lg:16px;--radius-xl:20px;--radius-2xl:28px;--radius-full:999px;

  /* elevation */
  --elev-card:0 8px 24px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.28),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  --elev-popover:0 24px 64px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.45),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06);

  /* type */
  --font-shell:'Geist',system-ui,sans-serif;--font-shell-mono:'Geist Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;
  /* Compatibility aliases, removed with Phase 4 remediation. */
  --bg:var(--bg-stage);--bg-2:var(--bg-surface);--bg-3:var(--bg-raised);--chrome:var(--bg-canvas);--chrome-2:var(--bg-overlay);
  --line:var(--border-default);--line-2:var(--border-strong);--text:var(--text-primary);--text-2:var(--text-secondary);--text-3:var(--text-tertiary);
  --accent:var(--accent-default);--accent-dim:var(--accent-subtle);--mono:var(--font-shell-mono);--sans:var(--font-shell);--radius:var(--radius-md);
  color-scheme:dark;
}
[data-theme="light"]{
  color-scheme:light;
  --bg-canvas:var(--p-gray-25);--bg-surface:var(--p-gray-0);--bg-raised:var(--p-gray-50);--bg-stage:var(--p-gray-50);--bg-overlay:var(--p-gray-0);
  --border-subtle:rgba(0,0,0,.06);--border-default:rgba(0,0,0,.09);--border-strong:rgba(0,0,0,.14);--border-highlight:rgba(0,0,0,.04);
  --text-primary:var(--p-gray-950);--text-secondary:#5C5C5C;--text-tertiary:#666;--text-inverse:var(--p-gray-0);
  --accent-hover:var(--p-orange-600);--accent-subtle:rgba(250,115,25,.10);--pro-default:var(--text-primary);
  --status-success:var(--p-green-600);--status-danger:var(--p-red-600);--focus-ring:var(--p-orange-600);
}
/* stage-only light mode (DRAMS, skeuomorph, paper): same tokens scoped to the stage */
.stage[data-stage-theme="light"]{ --bg-stage:#F4F4F4; color-scheme:light; }

:root {
  /* duration */
  --dur-micro: 80ms;     /* press-in, tooltip delay */
  --dur-quick: 150ms;    /* hover in, closes, colour */
  --dur-fast: 250ms;     /* menus, modals, tabs, accordions */
  --dur-medium: 350ms;   /* panels, toasts, toggles, check draw */
  --dur-slow: 400ms;     /* text swaps, reveals */
  --dur-xslow: 500ms;    /* icon swaps, pop-in scale */
  --stagger: 40ms;

  /* easing */
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);        /* default for enter, move, resize */
  --ease-close: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);        /* exits that should feel decisive */
  --ease-in-out: ease-in-out;                        /* cross-fades, pulses */
  --ease-pop: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.36, 0.64, 1);     /* scale-in with a 1.03 peak */
  --ease-settle: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.25, 0.64, 1);  /* panels and morphs opening */
  --ease-bounce: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.35, 0.64, 1);  /* toggle thumb */
  --ease-pop-strong: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.96, 0.64, 1); /* like-heart only */
  --ease-step: cubic-bezier(0.35, -0.02, 0.43, 1);   /* number drum steps */
  /* linear: only continuous loops, shimmers, marquees and scroll scrubbing */

  /* distance / scale / blur */
  --move-micro: 4px; --move-small: 6px; --move-base: 8px; --move-medium: 12px; --move-large: 30px;
  --scale-large: 0.96; --scale-medium: 0.97; --scale-small: 0.98; --scale-tiny: 0.99;
  --blur-small: 2px; --blur-medium: 3px; --blur-large: 8px;
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

}


/* Foundation kit. Shell controls never reach into a demo's own markup. */
.btn,.chip,.icon-btn,.dock-btn,.kbd {
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0;
  border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius-full);text-decoration:none;
  font:500 13px/16px var(--font-shell);color:var(--text-primary);
}
.btn,.chip,.icon-btn,.dock-btn {
  cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;
  transition:background var(--dur-quick) var(--ease-out),color var(--dur-quick) var(--ease-out),
    border-color var(--dur-quick) var(--ease-out),filter var(--dur-quick) var(--ease-out),transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-pop);
}
.btn { height:36px;padding:0 16px; }
.btn--sm { height:28px;padding:0 12px;font-size:12px; }
.btn--accent { background:var(--accent-default);color:var(--text-inverse); }
.btn--primary { background:var(--text-primary);color:var(--text-inverse); }
.btn--secondary { background:var(--bg-raised);border-color:var(--border-default); }
.btn--ghost { background:transparent;color:var(--text-secondary); }
.chip { height:32px;padding:0 12px;background:var(--bg-surface);border:1px solid var(--border-subtle);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:normal;color:var(--text-secondary); }
.chip .n { font:500 11px/14px var(--font-shell-mono);color:var(--text-tertiary); }
.chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background:var(--text-primary);color:var(--text-inverse);border-color:transparent; }
.chip[aria-pressed="true"] .n { color:inherit;opacity:.6; }
.badge--new,.badge--pro,.badge--lib,.badge--soon {
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:20px;padding:0 7px;border:1px solid transparent;
  border-radius:var(--radius-full);font:500 10px/14px var(--font-shell-mono);letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;
}
.badge--new { background:var(--accent-subtle);color:var(--accent-default); }
.badge--pro { background:transparent;border-color:var(--border-strong);color:var(--pro-default); }
.badge--lib { background:var(--bg-raised);color:var(--text-secondary); }
.badge--soon { background:var(--bg-raised);color:var(--text-tertiary); }
.icon-btn { width:32px;height:32px;padding:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text-secondary); }
.icon-btn[aria-pressed="true"],.icon-btn.is-active { background:var(--bg-overlay);border-color:var(--border-strong);color:var(--text-primary); }
.icon-btn>svg,.icon-btn>img { width:16px;height:16px;flex:none; }
.kit-replay { background:url('../assets/kit/replay.svg') center no-repeat;width:16px;height:16px; }
.icon-btn[aria-pressed="true"] .kit-replay { background-image:url('../assets/kit/replay-active.svg'); }
.dock-btn { height:28px;padding:0 12px;font-size:12px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg-overlay) 72%,transparent);border-color:var(--border-highlight);backdrop-filter:blur(12px); }
.kbd { height:20px;padding:0 6px;border-color:var(--border-default);border-radius:var(--radius-xs);background:var(--bg-raised);color:var(--text-tertiary);font:500 11px/14px var(--font-shell-mono); }
.btn:focus-visible,.chip:focus-visible,.icon-btn:focus-visible,.dock-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring);outline-offset:2px; }
.btn:active,.chip:active,.icon-btn:active,.dock-btn:active { transform:scale(.97);transition-duration:var(--dur-micro);transition-timing-function:var(--ease-out); }
.btn:disabled,.chip:disabled,.icon-btn:disabled,.dock-btn:disabled { opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none; }
@media(hover:hover) {
  .btn:hover,.dock-btn:hover { filter:brightness(1.06); }
  .chip:hover { border-color:var(--border-strong);color:var(--text-primary); }
  .chip[aria-pressed="true"]:hover { color:var(--text-inverse); }
  .icon-btn:hover { background:var(--bg-overlay);color:var(--text-primary); }
}
.kit-tile { display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--border-default);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:none; }
.kit-tile .stage { position:relative;height:264px;flex:none;overflow:hidden; }
.kit-tile .stage[data-stage-theme="light"] { margin:6px 6px 0;border-radius:13px;background:#F4F4F2; }
.kit-tile .stage[data-stage-theme="light"]::before { content:'';position:absolute;pointer-events:none;top:-170px;left:-36px;width:420px;height:260px;background:url('../assets/kit/stage-glow.svg') center/contain no-repeat; }
.kit-tile-caption { padding:12px 14px 14px; }
.kit-tile-title { display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font:500 15px/20px var(--font-shell); }
.kit-tile-hint { margin-top:3px;font:400 13px/20px var(--font-shell);color:var(--text-secondary); }
.type-hero { font:600 64px/64px var(--font-shell);letter-spacing:-.03em; }
.type-h1 { font:600 40px/44px var(--font-shell);letter-spacing:-.02em; }
.type-h2 { font:600 28px/32px var(--font-shell);letter-spacing:-.015em; }
.type-h3 { font:500 20px/26px var(--font-shell);letter-spacing:-.01em; }
.type-h4 { font:500 16px/22px var(--font-shell);letter-spacing:-.005em; }
.type-body { font:400 14px/22px var(--font-shell); }
.type-meta { font:500 11px/14px var(--font-shell-mono);letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase; }
.type-code { font:400 12.5px/20px var(--font-shell-mono); }

Build a self-contained scroll-controlled circular fan gallery with seven editorial cards. The logical focus axis is angle zero. Normalize a focusable local scroller and compute travel=progress*(cardCount-1)*(360/cardCount). For each card, normalize index*step-travel into [-180,180], then place it with x=sin(angle)*radiusX and y=(1-cos(angle))*radiusY. Rotate with the angle, lower opacity with angular distance, scale the focused card up, and derive z-index from distance.

Select the active card by the smallest absolute normalized angle rather than hard-coded scroll bands. Synchronize its title, zero-padded counter, aria-current/aria-hidden state, progressbar value text, travel-angle telemetry, and global progress rail. Use passive scroll input with one requestAnimationFrame gate; native keyboard and touch scrolling remain authoritative.

First Work returns to zero and restores focus, switching smooth scroll to auto under prefers-reduced-motion. Use seven distinct art-directed cards, visible focus, responsive radii, overscroll containment, scoped CSS, and no dependencies.

Compose a native 320px-tall root that also fits a 300–320px-wide preview: 14px outer padding, a flexible local scrolling viewport, 9px regular Inter status text, and a compact 28px control row. Use mono only for technical readouts, a #0a0a0b root, graphite chrome, and #fa7319 progress/focus details. Size the content for this viewport directly rather than scaling an oversized scene. Use compact 125×160px graphite cards with fine vertical line artwork and Newsreader titles. Mark the active card with an orange border; the focus axis is a logical zero-angle reference.

Final typography: Use Newsreader at normal weight for the main editorial text. Use Inter for actions and readable interface copy; retain regular Inter small numeric readouts, coordinates and technical annotations. Keep material borders subdued and gradients broad with continuous, gentle falloff.

Use the final composition: regular Inter for interface text and all numerical values with tabular-nums; keep labels in sentence case, normal tracking, and weights 400–500. Remove decorative engineering headers, preserve functional controls and accessible status. Keep the native 320px stage and a restrained palette with subtle borders. Any deliberate Newsreader editorial text in the source remains editorial, not UI.
Use embedded photographic covers in the final version, with quiet Newsreader titles and regular Inter metadata. Remove synthetic striped-cover artwork; keep measured fan geometry, active-item semantics, progress and reset.
notes: Seven editorial cards travel around a circular fan as the local panel scrolls. The card nearest the focus axis is selected from angular distance, then raised, sharpened, and scaled without relying on hard-coded active ranges.
